name: entalpa
description: Adds the Entalpa remote MCP server and portable skills for implementing traceable requirements and generating grounded PRD or BRD documents. Requires an Entalpa account; your client signs in on first connect, with no API key to paste.

interface.longDescription: Adds the Entalpa remote MCP server and portable skills for implementing traceable requirements and generating grounded PRD or BRD documents. Requires an Entalpa account; your client signs in on first connect, with no API key to paste.
defaultPrompt: Use Entalpa to inspect my project, identify missing requirements, and preserve traceability.
Use Entalpa to implement the current requirements and record implementation evidence.
Use Entalpa to generate a grounded PRD or BRD from the current project.
